request:
Source ticket: MAG-25 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-25/inferred-capacity

Inferred Capacity. This data will be saved per vehicle. The idea is to calculate the value every time a record is inserted or updated into the charging module tables (charge_sessions and manual_charge_entries). The formula is inferred_capacity_calc = energy_added / ((end_soc - start_soc) / 100), calculated only when the record contains energy added, end battery % and start battery %; otherwise NULL. Acceptance criteria: the new column is created and calculated for existing rows in charge_sessions and manual_charge_entries. Picked up via /kkpa-pickup-linear-ticket with AUTOPILOT ON; pipeline scope HALT AFTER STEP 4 (artifacts only, no implementation).
